title: Important Things To Note About Customs Duties
body_markdown:
There is no doubt that one of the biggest challenges experienced when sending a package abroad is[customs clearance](https://www.instagram.com/p/CCvX31fnb9g/) . If mismanaged, you will find yourself getting confused, and this may lead to your shipments being held by customs which will cause delays in the delivering process.


#### In this post, we answer the occasionally asked questions about customs duties.


**Question: What are ‘’customs duties and taxes”**


Customs duties are taxes and levies paid on goods imported into the country. Import duties and taxes are calculated on shipments where necessary.


**Question: Why do I need to pay customs duty?**


Duties and taxes are most typically not included in the price of the goods you bought online, and might not be included in the overall shipping costs you pay to the online retailer. This is why your package is subject to an import procedure to clear the shipment through customs.


**Question: Are these customs charges included in the shipping fee?**


No, they are not. This is because they are to be paid directly to customs in destination countries.


**Question: Are customs laws and the duties the same in all countries?**


No, there are not as every country has its own customs laws and the duties for different types of goods and values are set locally for clearance.


**Question: Clearance is dependant on what?**


Clearance is dependant on 3 major things: the country of origin, the number and value of goods (including shipping charges).


**Question: Why am I asked to provide ‘’paperwork’’?**


Numerous countries require a commercial invoice when shipping non-document goods. You will need to accurately complete the relevant paperwork as it is needed to clear your shipment.


**Question: What additional charges can I expect following customs clearance?**


Depending on the value and the type of goods imported, you may expect the following charges:
- Customs import duties (percentage of shipment value and transport charges) or local tax
- Advance Payment surcharge
- Any regulatory charges, if applicable
